description: Find series by words in their id, title or coverage (all words must match; case and the ʻokina are ignored). Optional exact filters: geo, source, frequency. Returns up to 50 series a page (id, title, unit, frequency, geo, coverage, source). Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.

frequency.description: D daily, W weekly, M monthly, Q quarterly, A annual

geo.description: Geography code, e.g. HI, HI.HON, HI.HAW, HI.MAU, HI.KAU, HI.KAL, US

page.description: Page number (50 series a page); default 1

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "unemployment rate Kauai"

source.description: Source id from list_sources, e.g. BLS, BTS, CENSUSTRADE

name: search_series
title: Search the series catalog
